name: "Calm" - Class II

description.content: Increases your Terror Radius by [6m] while [Static Blast] is ready, and decreases it by [6m] while [Static Blast] is on cooldown.
Survivors with [Madness] suffer from the [Affliction of Calm]:

items: [Madness II]: Intermittently hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.
[Madness III]: Constantly hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.

quote: "Electroconvulsive therapy is one of the safest medical procedures." -Léry's Memorial Institute
